build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE physics task
create_dynamic_bars_with_C_add: add dynamic bar bodies to the scene using C.add with scale and positioning methods
position_bodies_with_setters: chain setter methods like set_bottom set_left set_angle and set_right to position scene bodies
create_dynamic_balls_with_C_add: add dynamic ball bodies to the scene using C.add and set their center coordinates
update_task_with_spatial_relationship: call C.update_task to define body1 body2 and a SpatialRelationship like ABOVE for the task goal
